subject: Security: provisioning Vendr profile + evidence playbook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Romero <nadia.romero@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security: provisioning Vendr profile + evidence playbook

Team —

Nimbus Health (contact Nadia, cc'd) just requested that we finish our Vendr security profile so they can close procurement. They want a completed SIG/CAIQ mapping and a bundle of evidentiary artifacts (SOC 2 excerpts, encryption config, retention policy snippets).

High-level asks:
- Get the Vendr portal invite accepted and confirm primary owner.
- Produce a one-page evidence index (CSV) that maps each vendor portal question to the supporting doc/artifact.
- Attach sample screenshots for any infra config (S3 bucket settings, KMS key policy).
- Flag gaps where we need SOC 2 excerpts or current CAIQ answers — we'll escalate to Security for those.

Initial timeline: 48 hours to accept invite + draft index; 5 business days to complete artifacts. If we need SOC 2 excerpts sooner, we'll request an expedited pull from Compliance.

Monica — can you take portal ownership and accept the invite when Vendr sends it? Please also start the evidence_index.csv template.
Marcus — can you pull the latest CAIQ mapping and drop a preliminary caiq_mapping.xlsx into the shared folder; call out any questions for Security.

Nadia — thanks for coordinating on the Nimbus procurement side. If Vendr support needs to expedite provisioning on their end, can you loop them in?

Attachments: evidence_index.csv (template draft), caiq_mapping.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

1) I will be the primary Vendr profile owner and will accept the invite when it arrives.
2) I started the evidence_index.csv and populated the first rows (SOC2 report location, retention policy doc).
3) Two immediate needs from Marcus/Security:
   - Latest SOC 2 sysdesc and scoped control list (Security: can you confirm if we can share the June 2026 SOC 2 report excerpt?).
   - A screenshot of the S3 bucket policy and KMS key alias for the model artifacts bucket. Marcus, can you upload a screenshot (evidence_sample_screenshot.png) to the Drive link below?

Proposed owner assignments (quick):
- Evidence index master: Monica Patel
- CAIQ mapping lead: Marcus Lin
- SOC 2 excerpts request / compliance liaison: Aditya to escalate w/ Security

I'll draft a short playbook doc in the Drive folder that outlines "what Vendr expects" (question types, file naming, evidence size limits). Once Vendr confirms invite, I'll upload the portal screenshots and the CSV.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Q2wE4-evidence-playbook

Monica

Hi Monica / Aditya —

Thanks for the heads up. I've set up a portal invitation for Monica (sent to monica_patel@redwood.com). Steps to finish onboarding:

1) Accept invite: https://vendr.com/portal/invite/XYZ-abc-123 (link valid for 72 hours)
2) Upload your evidence_index.csv and use the "Attach as evidence" flow for the following: SOC 2 excerpt (PDF), CAIQ mapping (XLSX), and screenshots.
3) Maximum file size per upload is 50MB. If you have larger logs, use our secure S3 transfer and share the transfer link.
4) If you need us to pre-populate low-risk answers for quick procurement checks, reply with the list of questions — we can load defaults in 24 hours.

I've attached a short instructions PDF that covers the upload UI and naming conventions.

Let me know if you want us to schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow morning.

Regards,
Diego Ramos
Vendor Onboarding — Vendr Support
security@vendr.com
